title: Comparing fractions with the same top number
familyTitle: Comparing two fractions with the same bottom or top number
skill: Compare two fractions with the same numerator: more equal parts in the whole means each part is smaller.

knowledge: a fraction a/b means a of b equal parts of one whole
the parts must be equal and of the same whole

concept: The bottom number says how many equal parts the whole is cut into. Cutting the same whole into more parts makes each part smaller.
So with the same top number (the same number of parts), the fraction with the smaller bottom number is greater.

visual.note: 1/9: the same whole cut into 9 equal parts
1/11: the same whole cut into 11 equal parts

explanation.visualNote: Reuses the family's own grid strip (adfcmp draw_both: {type:'grid', rows:1, cols:b, shaded:a}) once per fraction; the two strips must be drawn the SAME length. The existing Visual union has no two-strip comparison; draw two grid strips.

workedExamples.prompt: Which fraction is greater: 1/9 or 1/11? Write that fraction.
lines: Both fractions have 1 part. In 1/9 the whole is cut into 9 equal parts; in 1/11 into 11.
Cutting the same whole into fewer parts makes each part bigger, so 1/9 is greater.
The greater fraction is 1/9.
familyExplainSteps: Both have the same number of parts on top. The bottom number tells how many equal parts the whole is cut into: more parts are smaller parts. So 1/9 and 1/11 compare the other way to their bottom numbers.

workedExamples.prompt: Which fraction is smaller: 1/3 (one-third) or 1/9? Write that fraction.
lines: Both fractions have 1 part. In 1/3 the whole is cut into 3 equal parts; in 1/9 into 9.
Cutting the same whole into fewer parts makes each part bigger, so 1/3 is greater.
The smaller fraction is 1/9.
familyExplainSteps: Both have the same number of parts on top. The bottom number tells how many equal parts the whole is cut into: more parts are smaller parts. So 1/3 and 1/9 compare the other way to their bottom numbers.

hints: Is the top number or the bottom number the same?
Both have 1 part. Which whole is cut into bigger parts: 9 parts or 11 parts?
A whole cut into 9 parts has the bigger parts, so 1/9 is greater.
Is the top number or the bottom number the same?
Both have 1 part. Which whole is cut into bigger parts: 3 parts or 9 parts?
A whole cut into 3 parts has the bigger parts, so 1/3 is greater.

alternativeExplanation.title: Sharing a roti
text: Share one roti among a few children, and an identical roti among more children.
In the bigger group each child gets less: more sharers, smaller shares.

alternativeMethods.name: Compare part size (same top) or part count (same bottom)
example: Both have 1 part. A whole cut into 9 parts has bigger parts than one cut into 11.
So 1/9 is greater; the greater is 1/9.

alternativeMethods.name: Common denominator (later grades; computing check)
example: 11/99 is more, so the greater fraction is 1/9

misconceptions.status: modelled (a single matching answer is a SUSPECTED error; established only under misconception-evidence@1: two matching answers)
misconceptions.note: whole-number thinking: a bigger denominator is read as a bigger fraction

whatWentWrong: In "Which fraction is greater: 1/9 or 1/10? Write that fraction.", one wrong answer is 1/10.
The fraction with the bigger bottom number was chosen as greater. A bigger bottom number means the whole is cut into more parts, so each part is smaller.
A bigger bottom number means MORE pieces from the same whole, so each piece is SMALLER.
screens.counterCheck: Check with two strips of the SAME length: cut one into 9 equal parts and the other into 10. One part of the 10-part strip is shorter than one part of the 9-part strip, so 1/10 is less than 1/9.
solvedCorrectly: Both fractions have 1 part. In 1/9 the whole is cut into 9 equal parts; in 1/10 into 10.
Cutting the same whole into fewer parts makes each part bigger, so 1/9 is greater.
